splash.subtitle: a quiet story you can take your time with

intro.slide0a: You are a professor at an elite university. Students love you, colleagues respect you, and you enjoy your subject.
intro.slide0b: Lately, you've felt the need to put your ideas into a book. A sabbatical gives you a full paid year to do it.
intro.slide1a: Over the summer, you finished your other work and rented a house on a remote island. There should be nothing there to distract you. You might even write two books.
intro.slide1b: Your laptop and papers are packed. A small boat is taking you to your new home for the next year. The landlord should be waiting at the dock to show you around.
